extract: John Kevin "Jake" Ellzey Sr. is an American politician and former military officer serving as the U.S. representative for Texas's 6th congressional district since 2021. A member of the Republican Party, he previously served as a commissioner for the Texas Veterans Commission and later as a member of the Texas House of Representatives for the 10th district from January to July 2021.
